invariants.rationale: Record size estimates and commit metadata are all non-negative quantities, so result representing an average byte size cannot be negative.
The average record size cannot be larger than the small file limit used as a threshold.
If timeline is not empty and a newer estimate is found, result could be greater than the default estimate; otherwise, for empty timelines or failed estimation, the default is returned.
If the timeline is not empty, average size is estimated with respect to file limits, so should not exceed the limit.
If there is no commit history, the result defaults to the static estimate from the config.
